St. Eunan’s Cathedr al Letterkenny NEWSLETTER Sunday 22nd Novem ber 2026 Our Lord Jesus Christ , King of the Univ erse “WAITI NGFOR CHRISTM AS” You are invited to a ‘TIME OF PRAYER’ in St. Eunan’s Cathedral to prepare for Christmas, on Friday 27th November from 8 pm - 9.45 pm . In this busy time of the year, Advent can be forgotten easily. This evening of prayer will help us enter the Season of Advent as a Parish. It will include a reflection, music, and will conclude with Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament. ADVENT LECTIO DIVINA Would you like to prepare for the Sunday Mass by prayerfully reading the Scriptures? Join Liam Coyle [on placement with us from Maynooth] on Monday evenings at the Divine Mercy Centre at 7 pm: beginning Monday 23rd November , in preparation for the First Sunday of Advent WREATH MAKING will take place on Saturday 28th November from 11 am - 1 pm in the Divine Mercy Centre. Some resources will be available on the day, but you are welcome to bring your own materials if possible: candles (3 x purple, 1 x pink and optional 1 x white); greenery. This will be an excellent opportunity for families and individuals to prepare for a meaningful pre-Christmas season. ST PIUS X ADORATION CHAPEL: Would you consider increasing your prayer life by one hour in the week? Have you recently retired from the working world and have more time now? Would you give one hour of your week in prayer to remember a deceased loved one? Have you gratitude in your heart and wish to share this with the Lord? Are you troubled and carrying the worries of life and would like to offload to the Lord? Next weekend, 28th & 29th November, St. Pius X Adoration Chapel Committee Members will be available at the back of the Cathedral at the end of all Masses to take names of anyone interested in committing to an hour of prayer per week. Maybe a family would sign up, this reduces the stress/anxiety of missing your hour due to sickness/travel. There are some hours in need of cover but it is always an hour that suits you most. Mondays: 7 pm Cathedral

The cards are ON SALE in the Parochial House ; Cathedral Sacristy; St. Paul’s Books and Gifts, Main Street; Clarkes Newsagents, Lower Main Street; County Dry Cleaners , Lower Main Street; Mac’s Deli , High Road; Kernan Lower Main Street, Kernan Oldtown; Kernan Tullygay and Tinney’s Oil , Bonagee. Any profit, after printing costs, will be donated to the local St. Vincent de Paul Society. The Sisters of Merciful Jesus invite you for an AFTERNOON RETREAT on Saturday 28th November in Divine Mercy Centre, Letterkenny. The theme is: “Advent with Merciful Jesus ” The retreat starts at 2 pm until 5.30 pm. It will consist of talks, prayer, refreshments, and sharing. You are very welcome. The CHARISMATIC PRAYER GROUP has been meeting faithfully in the Parish for over 50 years. We would welcome new members of our Parish Community to join us on a Thursday night from 8 pm to 9 pm in the Cathedral Conference Room . The content of our meeting is prayer and praise, and meditating on God’s word. People are invited to join us any time that your schedule permits.
